notes.title: Summer Sale - Thanks for the Support
notes.notes: [p]As the Steam Summer Sale enters its final days, I just wanted to say a huge [b]thank you[/b] to everyone who’s picked up [i]Keziah’s Realm[/i], left a review, or shared the game with friends. It really means the world — I’m a solo developer, and your support is what keeps this project alive and growing.[/p][p]Since the launch of [b]Trials Mode[/b], I’ve been reading feedback and working on a few improvements and bug fixes, which will come in the next few days.[/p]

notes.title: 🧿 New Feature: Trials Mode
notes.notes:
Enter the Trials — a standalone roguelike challenge designed to push your mastery of Keziah’s Realm to the limit.

Fight your way through a series of increasingly difficult clan strongholds

Adapt to randomized layouts, enemy lineups, and limited resources each run

Unlock new characters, each with distinct abilities and playstyles to shift your strategy

Every trial is a new opportunity… or your last.

notes.title: ⚔️ New Roguelike Game Mode: Coming soon!
notes.notes: [p]Today, I'm excited to announce something completely new for [i]Keziah’s Realm[/i]: a [b]roguelike-inspired challenge mode[/b] designed to push your skills and strategies to the limit.[/p][p][/p][h3]Welcome to [b]Trials Mode[/b][/h3][p]In this new optional game mode, you'll face a [b]series of enemy clan bases[/b], each one more dangerous than the last. With limited resources and no room for error, every decision counts. There are no do-overs — only progression or defeat.[/p][p][b]Key Features of Trials Mode:[/b][/p][list][*][p]🔥 Progressively harder clan encounters[/p][/*][*][p]🏕️ Randomized base layouts and enemies each run[/p][/*][*][p]🏅 Unlockable starting characters with unique perks [/p][/*][/list][p]Whether you're a veteran of the main game or looking for a new reason to dive in, [b]Trials Mode[/b] offers a fast-paced, high-stakes way to prove your mastery of the Realm.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]📅 Release Date[/h3][p]Trials Mode will be launching [b]later this month[/b] as part of a major update focused on polish, replayability, and player challenge.[/p]

notes.title: 🌀 Land of Chaos Update – Secret Ending
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] NPCs from the Land of Chaos now disguise themselves and infiltrate clans, aiming to steal relics and sabotage progress from within.
[*] Choose to defend your clan from these hidden enemies, or embrace the chaos and help them bring about a new age
[*] Not part of a clan by Day 5? Try wandering the Mycelium Biomes. You may encounter a shadowy figure offering you a deal that changes everything...
[/list]

notes.title: Information Update – Quality of Life Improvements
notes.notes:
This update brings some useful new features and improvements to help new players understand the game's mechanics such as:

🛠️ Crafting Recipes – Discover new ways to create useful items and gear on the inventory tab!
📜 Item Descriptions – Every item now includes a description, highlighting their use cases.
🧠 NPC Memories – When inspecting an NPC on the relationship tab, you can now see a list of all major events in their life.

Thanks for playing, and keep the feedback coming – it really helps shape the game!

notes.title: 🎉 Thank You for 10 Reviews – Keziah’s Realm is Now Reaching New Players!
notes.notes:
It's been an exciting week for Keziah’s Realm!

Thanks to your amazing support, we just hit 10 player reviews on Steam — and because of that, the game is now being recommended to new players on the Discovery Queue!

If you’ve been enjoying your time in the realm, leaving a short review helps more than you know — allowing more players discover and join the adventure. 

More updates are on the way with additional content, quality of life enhancements and bug fixes🌟

Over the next couple of weeks, there will be a heavy focus on improving the learning experience for new players, with in-game features such tool-tips/item descriptions and online help including guides and gameplay tutorials.

Thank you again for being part of this journey — it truly means the world to me as a solo developer.

See you in Keziah’s Realm!

notes.title: Bug Fixes, Leveling System and General Improvements
notes.notes:
With this update many bugs and issues have been resolved, along with several gameplay enhancements, such as:

[list]
[*] Leveling system, increasing maximum health and energy
[*] Status effects (Fire, Poison, Freeze, Sleep, Paralysis)
[*] Improved fishing mechanics
[*] Imprisonment system
[/list]
